phases.name: Cross
phases.description: Form a 4-edge cross on the bottom layer matching side center colors.

phases.name: Intuitive F2L (First Two Layers)
phases.description: Solve the first two layers simultaneously by pairing corner and edge pieces in the top layer and inserting them together into their slot.

algorithms.name: Basic Right Insertion
algorithms.condition: Corner and edge are already paired in top layer; target slot is Front-Right.

algorithms.name: Basic Left Insertion
algorithms.condition: Corner and edge are already paired in top layer; target slot is Front-Left.

algorithms.name: Dot Case
algorithms.condition: No top edges oriented. Execute Line alg, then L-shape alg.
algorithms.algorithm: F R U R' U' F' U2 F U R U' R' F'

algorithms.name: L-Shape
algorithms.condition: Two adjacent top edges oriented forming an L.
algorithms.algorithm: f R U R' U' f'

algorithms.name: Bar / Line Case
algorithms.condition: Two opposite top edges oriented forming a line.
algorithms.algorithm: F R U R' U' F'

algorithms.name: Sune
algorithms.condition: 1 corner oriented; top-left front corner sticker faces front.
algorithms.algorithm: R U R' U R U2 R'

algorithms.name: Anti-Sune
algorithms.condition: 1 corner oriented; top-right front corner sticker faces right.
algorithms.algorithm: R U2 R' U' R U' R'

algorithms.name: H (Double Headlight)
algorithms.condition: 0 corners oriented; two pairs of headlights facing front and back.

algorithms.name: Pi (Wheel)
algorithms.condition: 0 corners oriented; one pair of headlights on left, two corners pointing away on right.
algorithms.algorithm: R U2 R2 U' R2 U' R2 U2 R

algorithms.name: Headlights (U)
algorithms.condition: 2 corners oriented; remaining two stickers face front.
algorithms.algorithm: R2 D R' U2 R D' R' U2 R'

algorithms.name: Chameleon (T)
algorithms.condition: 2 corners oriented; remaining stickers face left and right.
algorithms.algorithm: r U R' U' r' F R F'

algorithms.name: Bowtie (L)
algorithms.algorithm: F' r U R' U' r' F R

algorithms.name: T Permutation (Headlights Case)
algorithms.condition: One side has two matching corners (headlights). Put headlights on Left.
algorithms.algorithm: R U R' U' R' F R2 U' R' U' R U R' F'

algorithms.name: Y Permutation (No Headlights Case)
algorithms.condition: No sides have matching corners. Swaps diagonal corners.
algorithms.algorithm: F R U' R' U' R U R' F' R U R' U' R' F R F'

algorithms.name: Ua Perm (3-Edge Clockwise Cycle)
algorithms.condition: 1 solved edge bar; remaining 3 edges cycle clockwise.
algorithms.algorithm: R U' R U R U R U' R' U' R2

algorithms.name: Ub Perm (3-Edge Counter-Clockwise Cycle)
algorithms.condition: 1 solved edge bar; remaining 3 edges cycle counter-clockwise.
algorithms.algorithm: R2 U R U R' U' R' U' R' U R'

algorithms.name: H Perm (Opposite Edge Swap)
algorithms.condition: No solved bars; opposite edges swap across center.
algorithms.algorithm: M2 U M2 U2 M2 U M2

algorithms.name: Z Perm (Adjacent Edge Swap)
algorithms.condition: No solved bars; adjacent edges swap.
algorithms.algorithm: M' U M2 U M2 U M' U2 M2
